note: CMS schema for the LastPass support portal page types, organized the way an editor fills them in. Field types use the lastpass_cms manifest vocabulary (tools/schema-gen.mjs turns manifests into Schema Designer XDR) and groups follow docs/spec/field-groups.json (collapsible blocks in the edit form). Each field: name (stable element name), label (what the editor sees), type, required, help, and optional values/default/max. categories are CMS taxonomy tags on the page or tray; trays is the page's Page Builder area. Covers only the net-new work: the Flex page type, three special page types, five trays and four components. The header, footer, article, search and other built pages are out of scope. Drives the schema tabs in components.html and the CMS schema panel on every page.

flex.about: The Flex page type: any page built from trays (hubs, topic overviews, FAQ, contact, landing pages). Fill in the page basics, then stack trays in Page Builder. The first tray is always a Hero.

fields.name: Title

fields.name: Description

fields.help: What search engines and Coveo show under the link. Up to 160 characters.
fields.why: Plain, with a character limit: search snippets drop formatting and cut long text.

fields.name: Product

fields.why: Taxonomy, so one tag drives scoped search, facets and record lists.

fields.name: BrowserTitle

fields.why: Plain text: browser tabs can't show formatting.

fields.name: PageNav

fields.why: One switch on the page: the list builds itself from the trays’ section headings, so adding, renaming or reordering a tray updates it.

fields.name: Trays

fields.help: Add Hero, Feature, Cards, FAQ and Content trays in Page Builder, in any order after the Hero.
fields.why: A list of tray components, the same field the build’s other pages use: Page Builder adds, orders and removes them.

scope.hero: Builds on the hero and search band already built for the home page: adds layout, style and the media slot.
scope.cards: Builds on the Featured Documentation cards already built: adds card styles, columns and cards from a guide.
scope.FAQ item: New. A shared library of questions.
scope.Notice: New for authors; uses the DITA note style already built.

element_rule: As tools/schema-gen.mjs writes them: rich xhtml_Name, image xpowerasset_Name, link xpowerlink_Name, component xpowercomponent_Name. A list field is named for one item: Button becomes xpowerlist_Buttons (Name + s, or Name + List when it already ends in s), each item xpowercomponent_Button (or xpowerlink_ for links), accepting its own child schema (Schema + Name, e.g. HeroButton) or a shared one (Card, FaqItem). The page’s trays are xpowerlist_Trays, each item a Tray, accepting the tray schemas. Taxonomy categories are not schema elements.
grouping_rule: Schemas of 6 fields or fewer are one list with no groups. Longer schemas use groups of 3 or more fields; the exception is a small collapsible group for rarely used options (Schedule, Tray settings).
simplifications: A tag on a tray, matched to one plan value from sign-in. No rules engine; LastPass only needs to send the plan.
Every release and issue has its own link on its list page, and a link can open the list filtered to one product.
Trays never read records. A Flex page links to the record pages, already filtered; a hub's short list is written by hand.
Release notes and Known issues are pages, so Coveo indexes them like any other. No custom facets.
The image field on Hero and Feature takes an optional Vimeo link and becomes its poster. No separate video feature.
One Product tag list the records share. Downloads read their version from the newest release with the same tag.
